text_en: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of King Jehoiakim son of Josiah of Judah (that was the first year of King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon),
text_cn: 犹大王约史雅的儿子约雅金执政第四年，巴比伦王拿步高元年，有关于全犹大人民的话，传给耶肋米亚；

text_en: which the prophet Jeremiah spoke to all the people of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem:
text_cn: 耶肋米亚先知便将这话转告给全犹大人民，和耶路撒冷所有的居民说：

text_en: For twenty-three years, from the thirteenth year of King Josiah son of Amon of Judah, to this day, the word of the Lord has come to me, and I have spoken persistently to you, but you have not listened.
text_cn: “自犹大王阿孟的儿子约史雅执政第十三年，直到今日，已经二十三年，凡上主传给我的话，我都急速告诉了你们，你们却不听。

text_en: And though the Lord persistently sent you all his servants the prophets, you have neither listened nor inclined your ears to hear
text_cn: 上主不断给你们派来他所有的仆人──先知们，你们总是不听，不愿倾耳谛听。

text_en: when they said, “Turn now, every one of you, from your evil way and wicked doings, and you will remain upon the land that the Lord has given to you and your ancestors from of old and forever;
text_cn: 他们说：你们应各自离弃自己的邪道，和自己邪恶的行为，好能住在上主从永远到永远赐给了你们和你们祖先的地域里；

text_en: do not go after other gods to serve and worship them, and do not provoke me to anger with the work of your hands. Then I will do you no harm. ”
text_cn: 不要追随其他的神祇，事奉朝拜，以你们手做的东西来激怒我，你们就不致遭遇灾祸。

text_en: Yet you did not listen to me, says the Lord , and so you have provoked me to anger with the work of your hands to your own harm.
text_cn: 你们没有听从我──上主的断语──竟以你们手做的东西来激怒我，自招祸患。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord of hosts: Because you have not obeyed my words,
text_cn: 为此，万军的上主这样说：由于你们不听我的话，

text_en: I am going to send for all the tribes of the north, says the Lord , even for King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon, my servant, and I will bring them against this land and its inhabitants, and against all these nations around; I will utterly destroy them, and make them an object of horror and of hissing, and an everlasting disgrace.
text_cn: 看，我必遣人召来北方的一切种族──上主的断语──和我的仆人巴比伦王拿步高来进攻这地方，和这地方的居民，以及四周所有的民族；我要彻底消灭，任其荒凉，永远成为笑柄和羞辱的对象。

text_en: And I will banish from them the sound of mirth and the sound of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones and the light of the lamp.
text_cn: 此外，我还要息灭他们中欢乐喜庆的歌声，新郎和新娘的欢笑声，磨声和灯光。

text_en: This whole land shall become a ruin and a waste, and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
text_cn: 这地方要全变为凄凉的荒野，这些民族要七十年服从巴比伦王。

text_en: Then after seventy years are completed, I will punish the king of Babylon and that nation, the land of the Chaldeans, for their iniquity, says the Lord , making the land an everlasting waste.
text_cn: 但是，一满了七十年，我必要惩罚巴比伦王和这民族的罪恶──上主的断语──以及加色丁人的国土，使它永远成为荒野。

text_en: I will bring upon that land all the words that I have uttered against it, everything written in this book, which Jeremiah prophesied against all the nations.
text_cn: 对这国土，我要执行我论它所说，在这书上所记载先知耶肋米亚论及万民所预言的一切话，

text_en: For many nations and great kings shall make slaves of them also; and I will repay them according to their deeds and the work of their hands.
text_cn: 因为强盛的民族和有力的君王，要使他们成为自己的奴隶；我必依照他们的作为和他们双手所行的事，报复他们。

text_en: For thus the Lord , the God of Israel, said to me: Take from my hand this cup of the wine of wrath, and make all the nations to whom I send you drink it.
text_cn: 上主，以色列的天主这样对我说：“你从我手中接过这杯忿怒酒去，让我派你所到的各民族喝。

text_en: They shall drink and stagger and go out of their minds because of the sword that I am sending among them.
text_cn: 他们必要喝，必要在我给他们派来的刀剑前，蹒跚发狂。”

text_en: So I took the cup from the Lord ’s hand, and made all the nations to whom the Lord sent me drink it:
text_cn: 我便从上主手中接过杯来，给了上主派我所到的各民族喝：

text_en: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, its kings and officials, to make them a desolation and a waste, an object of hissing and of cursing, as they are today;
text_cn: 给耶路撒冷和犹大各城市，以及城中的君王和首长喝，使她们荒芜凄凉，受人嘲笑诅咒，像今日一样；

text_en: Pharaoh king of Egypt, his servants, his officials, and all his people;
text_cn: 给埃及王法郎和他的臣仆王侯并全体人民；

text_en: all the mixed people; all the kings of the land of Uz; all the kings of the land of the Philistines—Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;
text_cn: 给所有的杂族，胡兹地和培肋舍特地的众君王；给阿市刻隆、迦萨、厄刻龙和阿市多得的遗民；

text_en: Edom, Moab, and the Ammonites;
text_cn: 给厄东、摩阿布和阿孟子民；

text_en: all the kings of Tyre, all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the coastland across the sea;
text_cn: 给提洛、漆冬和海外岛屿的众君王；

text_en: Dedan, Tema, Buz, and all who have shaven temples;
text_cn: 给德丹、特玛、步次和凡剃除鬓发的人；

text_en: all the kings of Arabia and all the kings of the mixed peoples that live in the desert;
text_cn: 给阿剌伯和在沙漠居住的杂族的众君王；

text_en: all the kings of Zimri, all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of Media;
text_cn: 给齐默黎、厄蓝和玛待的众君王；

text_en: all the kings of the north, far and near, one after another, and all the kingdoms of the world that are on the face of the earth. And after them the king of Sheshach shall drink.
text_cn: 给北方彼此相离或远或近的众君王，以及地面上所有的王国喝；最后喝的，是舍沙客的君王。

text_en: Then you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: Drink, get drunk and vomit, fall and rise no more, because of the sword that I am sending among you.
text_cn: 你应对他们说：“万军的上主，以色列的天主这样说：你们要喝，喝醉，呕吐，倒在我给你们派来的刀剑前，再不起来。

text_en: And if they refuse to accept the cup from your hand to drink, then you shall say to them: Thus says the Lord of hosts: You must drink!
text_cn: 假使他们不肯从你手中取过杯去喝，你就对他们说：万军的上主这样说：你们必须喝。

text_en: See, I am beginning to bring disaster on the city that is called by my name, and how can you possibly avoid punishment? You shall not go unpunished, for I am summoning a sword against all the inhabitants of the earth, says the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 因为，看，我开始降罚归我名下的城市，而你们竟想全然免罚吗？你们决不能免罚，因为我要给地上所有的居民招来刀剑──万军上主的断语。

text_en: You, therefore, shall prophesy against them all these words, and say to them: The Lord will roar from on high, and from his holy habitation utter his voice; he will roar mightily against his fold, and shout, like those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.
text_cn: 你应给他们预言这一切话，对他们说：上主从高处作狮吼，从他的圣所发出他的声音，对自己的牧场厉声怒号，对地上所有的居民，像榨葡萄的人一样喊叫。

text_en: The clamor will resound to the ends of the earth, for the Lord has an indictment against the nations; he is entering into judgment with all flesh, and the guilty he will put to the sword, says the Lord .
text_cn: 一阵喧哗嘈杂，直至地极，因为上主与万民有了争讼，与一切有血肉的人，进行审判，将恶人交给刀剑──上主的断语──

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: See, disaster is spreading from nation to nation, and a great tempest is stirring from the farthest parts of the earth!
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：看，各国相继发生灾祸，由地极卷来强烈的风暴。

text_en: Those slain by the Lord on that day shall extend from one end of the earth to the other. They shall not be lamented, or gathered, or buried; they shall become dung on the surface of the ground.
text_cn: 到了那一天，从地极到地极，遍是上主杀戮（lù）的人，没有人哀悼、收殓、埋葬，有如地面上的粪土。

text_en: Wail, you shepherds, and cry out; roll in ashes, you lords of the flock, for the days of your slaughter have come—and your dispersions, and you shall fall like a choice vessel.
text_cn: 为人牧者，你们应哭泣哀号！为羊群领导者，你们应在灰尘中辗转！因为你们的日期已满，你们要被宰杀，快要被宰割，像精选的公羊。

text_en: Flight shall fail the shepherds, and there shall be no escape for the lords of the flock.
text_cn: 为人牧者，无路可逃；为羊群领导者，无法脱身。

text_en: Hark! the cry of the shepherds, and the wail of the lords of the flock! For the Lord is despoiling their pasture,
text_cn: 听啊！为人牧者在哀号，为羊群领导者在哭泣，因为上主摧毁了他们的牧场。

text_en: and the peaceful folds are devastated, because of the fierce anger of the Lord .
text_cn: 宁静的草场，因上主的怒焰，已成一片荒凉。

text_en: Like a lion he has left his covert; for their land has become a waste because of the cruel sword, and because of his fierce anger.
text_cn: 狮子离弃了自己的巢穴，因为它们的土地，由于刀剑的无情和上主的盛怒，已成了荒野。
